# VILLA — brief (Second Life, all mesh)

## What the owner asked (translated)
"A super modern, futuristic villa. PBR materials, organic shapes, a pool with customisation.
It turns into several different houses through a menu. Every luxury detail, and scripts to
customise everything. A very enveloping, cosy atmosphere, with furniture of the highest
quality. You are forbidden to use base primitives: only meshes."

## Fixed technical decisions
* Second Life, PBR viewer (glTF materials). EVERYTHING is uploaded mesh (DAE generated by our
  Python/Blender pipeline): no SL prims (boxes, cylinders...) anywhere, not even helpers.
* Everything in English (names, menus, docs).
* The house switcher is a REZZER: a small sculptural mesh controller ("Villa Core") holds the
  house variants (each a separate uploaded linkset) and rezzes / derezzes them from a menu.
  Furniture sets are separate linksets rezzed together with their house (so they can be moved).
* Budget per variant (shell + furniture + pool + landscaping): <= 400 land impact,
  footprint <= 36 x 36 m, height <= 12 m, max 256 links per linkset. Parcel assumed 4096 m².
* Faces: SL allows 8 per prim and SORTS them alphabetically by material name. Every piece uses
  these 8 slots (names sort in this order, so the face index is fixed):
    0 a_plaster (organic shell: microcement / plaster)   1 b_floor
    2 c_wood                                             3 d_stone (travertine, marble, basalt)
    4 e_fabric (upholstery, rugs, curtains)              5 f_metal (brass, steel, bronze)
    6 g_glass                                            7 h_glow (LED, lamp diffusers, fire)
  The pool water is its own piece with one material "water".
* Customisation = PBR material variants per slot (bulk-uploaded .glb, applied by script with
  PRIM_RENDER_MATERIAL) + glTF overrides (PRIM_GLTF_BASE_COLOR / PRIM_GLTF_EMISSIVE) for live
  colour tints (fabrics, LED colour, water colour), lights, scenes, pool features, glass tint,
  curtains, doors, fireplace, ambient sound, access list, presets — all from menus, every
  feature switchable.
* Organic shapes: subdivision surfaces, lofts, sweeps, smooth booleans in Blender (bpy module),
  then decimated LODs; physics as simple hull/box meshes so avatars walk everywhere.
* Install must take as few steps as possible.
